atom:entry.atom:title: EU PSR: Council first-reading position
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Track the EU legislative process; this milestone is not an application date. Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents adoption of its first-reading position on 29 October. This is a legislative milestone, not an application date. PSD3 and PSR must be tracked separately; no implementation date is asserted here. Who: EU payment providers; not automatically UK firms. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15154-2026-INIT/en/pdf

atom:entry.atom:title: PSD3: a separate Council milestone
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Track PSD3 separately from PSR; do not treat this vote as a go-live date. Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents its first-reading position on the payment and electronic-money services directive on 29 October. This is not an implementation deadline. Who: EU payment and e-money institutions; not automatically UK firms. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15152-2026-INIT/en/pdf

atom:entry.atom:title: UK scheme pricing: evidence required
atom:entry.atom:summary: [deadline] So what for merchants: Ask for evidence behind relevant UK scheme-fee decisions, not a savings promise. Preview, pending Avi’s review. Relevant scheme-fee decisions must comply with the PSR’s pricing-governance direction from the end of November. Who: Visa, Mastercard and UK acquirers. Effective: 2026-11-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

atom:entry.atom:title: UK fee transparency: next stage
atom:entry.atom:summary: [deadline] So what for merchants: Prepare to reconcile fee triggers with acquiring invoices. Preview, pending Avi’s review. Substantive information, transparency and complexity requirements apply from the end of July 2027, subject to the limited fee-logic extension. Who: Visa, Mastercard and UK acquirers. Effective: 2027-07-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

atom:entry.atom:title: Small fee lines: a limited extension
atom:entry.atom:summary: [deadline] So what for merchants: Some fee logic arrives later; acquirers can request it during the extension. Preview, pending Avi’s review. ITC Standard B is deferred for qualifying fee lines generating £850,000 or less in annual UK gross revenue. During the extension, acquirers can request that information without charge. Who: UK acquirers and scheme billing teams. Effective: 2029-07-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/media/nqoettxg/ps26-1-sp-fees-market-review-extensions-decision-aug-2026.pdf

atom:entry.atom:title: Safeguarding: the operating baseline
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Check how your provider reconciles and safeguards customer funds. Preview, pending Avi’s review. Daily reconciliations, monthly reports and resolution packs form part of the strengthened safeguarding regime. Audit requirements have exceptions. Who: UK payment and e-money firms. Effective: 2026-05-07. Official source: https://www.fca.org.uk/firms/emi-payment-institutions-safeguarding-requirements

atom:entry.atom:title: CHAPS: November release deferred
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Remove the superseded November release from your implementation plan. Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Bank of England deferred its entire November 2026 RTGS standards release. This notice does not establish a replacement deadline. Who: CHAPS and RTGS participants. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news/2026/august/delay-to-the-november-2026-rtgs-standards-release
